title: LectureLens
auto-waiting: Auto crop waiting · full frame kept
auto-limit: Auto crop test limit reached (10 requests) · full frame kept
auto-detecting: Detecting educational area · recording can start now
auto-scene-changed: Scene changed · full frame kept while checking
auto-unavailable: Auto crop unavailable · full frame kept; manual crop is available
auto-no-region: No clear educational area · full frame kept
no-educational-region: No educational area detected · full frame kept
region-uncertain: Region uncertain: full-frame candidates kept for review.
layout-change-review: Layout changed: checking the new region.
region-relocated: New slide region confirmed across samples.
cropHelp: Open the large editor, drag around the slide, then save your selection. Audio stays continuous; slides are checked every 5 seconds.
invalidCrop: Choose a valid slide rectangle before starting.
cropReview: Choose your slide area before recording
heading: One lesson tab. Only its picture and sound.
intro: Start in the Chrome extension on your class tab. Changing to another tab does not change the selected source.
step1: Load the LectureLens extension in Chrome using the setup guide.
step2: Open your BigBlueButton class tab and click the extension icon.
step3: Confirm permission, preview, check the sound, then start recording.
scope: This prototype captures browser tabs only. Zoom and Teams desktop apps are planned later.
privacy: Only the selected tab’s picture and audio. Keep that tab on your lesson.
limitation: Audio and slides stay on this device. Study notes and PDF are coming later.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this session's raw recording?
exported: Recording reconstructed in its session folder.
stopRequested: Stop requested. Keep Chrome open while the final chunks are saved.
consent: I have permission to record this class tab and its audio, and send occasional full-tab screenshots to Google Gemini for automatic crop. Free-tier images may improve Google products. Keep the API project on Free tier.
signal: Play class speech and check the sound meter before starting.
failed: Capture stopped with an error. Saved chunks remain on this device.
unavailable: Open a normal HTTPS class tab first.
connectFailed: Desktop connection unavailable. Run browser setup and check the native host registration.
navigation: Recording ended because the selected tab navigated or closed.
noSignal: No recent audio signal. Play class audio before starting.
noVideo: No video frames received from the tab.
sourceLocked: End the current capture before selecting another tab.
cropInstructions: Drag from one corner of the slide to the opposite corner. Everything outside the selection is excluded from saved slide images.
cropSaved: Slide area saved. Return to the extension to start recording.
cropUnavailable: Preview has ended. Close this window and preview the lesson again.
